# Xipe walks into a agriculture, food & harvest firm

Somewhere right now, in a agriculture, food & harvest office, someone is doing exactly what the myths describe — and has never heard of **Xipe**. This file is the introduction.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Origins.** Xipe appears in nahuatl tradition as spring, agriculture, flayed.  The name's meaning, "The flayed one", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Xipe in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.
